parameters.parameterName: ch_left_x: chamber left face (under the door)

ch_vert_z: bottom of the vertical walls
fp_x: front port centre x (at the chamber face)
fp_tilt: port axis above horizontal (looks down at the plate)
fp_yaw: port axis turned towards the left
fp_nut_face: nut front face out from the chamber face
fp_cover_sides: sides of AMAZEMET's LED cover
fp_cover_rot: cover polygon rotation (a flat at this angle)
fp_cover_face: cover front face out from the chamber face
fp_pod_angle: LED cable pod position round the cover (270 = 6 o'clock)
fp_pod_w: pod width (along the cover's flat)
fp_pod_h: pod height (radially out from the flat)
fp_pod_depth: pod depth (along the port axis)
fp_pod_setback: pod front face behind the cover face
door_open: how far the door opens
lp_ring_d: sight glass ring / nut OD
lp_protrusion: ring out from the door
stack_z: stack axis at the door's outer face
tw_len: window clear length (along the slope)
tw_plate_l: window frame plate length (along the slope)
aim_z: height of the melt the top camera aims at, on the furnace axis
